bread_basket.name: The Bread Basket Bakery Transaction & Production Dataset
bread_basket.description: 21,293 real customer transactions from The Bread Basket bakery in Edinburgh, UK, documenting bakery orders, item varieties, batch orders, and production timestamps.

software_effort_benchmarks.name: PROMISE Software Engineering Effort & Task Duration Repository (Desharnais, COCOMO-81, Pomodoro Tasks)
software_effort_benchmarks.description: Standard software engineering empirical datasets recording project complexity, lines of code/function points, team experience, estimated effort, and actual person-hours and duration.

dataco_supply_chain.name: DataCo Global Smart Supply Chain & Delivery Risk Dataset
dataco_supply_chain.description: Real-world supply chain and order fulfillment dataset with scheduled delivery days, real days to fulfillment, delivery status, and ground-truth Late_delivery_risk labels.

ai4i_manufacturing.name: UCI AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance & Production Dataset
ai4i_manufacturing.description: 10,000 real production machine runs capturing operational parameters, process temperatures, rotational tool speeds, tool wear in minutes, and failure modes.
